title: Discovery of Targets for Immune-Metabolic Antitumor Drugs Identifies Estrogen-Related Receptor Alpha.
authors: Sahu, Avinash; Wang, Xiaoman; Munson, Phillip; Klomp, Jan P G; Wang, Xiaoqing; Gu, Shengqing Stan; Han, Ya; Qian, Gege; Nicol, Phillip; Zeng, Zexian; Wang, Chenfei; Tokheim, Collin; Zhang, Wubing; Fu, Jingxin; Wang, Jin; Nair, Nishanth Ulhas; Rens, Joost A P; Bourajjaj, Meriem; Jansen, Bas; Leenders, Inge; Lemmers, Jaap; Musters, Mark; van Zanten, Sanne; van Zelst, Laura; Worthington, Jenny; Liu, Jun S; Juric, Dejan; Meyer, Clifford A; Oubrie, Arthur; Liu, X Shirley; Fisher, David E; Flaherty, Keith T
one_liner_zh: 该文开发多组学方法BipotentR识别肿瘤免疫代谢调控因子，虽用机器学习预测患者反应，但核心是药物靶点发现与免疫机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Drugs that kill tumors through multiple mechanisms have the potential for broad clinical benefits. Here, we first developed an in silico multiomics approach (BipotentR) to find cancer cell-specific regulators that simultaneously modulate tumor immunity and another oncogenic pathway and then used it to identify 38 candidate immune-metabolic regulators. We show the tumor activities of these regulators stratify patients with melanoma by their response to anti-PD-1 using machine learning and deep neural approaches, which improve the predictive power of current biomarkers. The topmost identified regulator, ESRRA, is activated in immunotherapy-resistant tumors. Its inhibition killed tumors by suppressing energy metabolism and activating two immune mechanisms: (i) cytokine induction, causing proinflammatory macrophage polarization, and (ii) antigen-presentation stimulation, recruiting CD8+ T cells into tumors. We also demonstrate a wide utility of BipotentR by applying it to angiogenesis and growth suppressor evasion pathways. BipotentR (http://bipotentr.dfci.harvard.edu/) provides a resource for evaluating patient response and discovering drug targets that act simultaneously through multiple mechanisms. SIGNIFICANCE: BipotentR presents resources for evaluating patient response and identifying targets for drugs that can kill tumors through multiple mechanisms concurrently. Inhibition of the topmost candidate target killed tumors by suppressing energy metabolism and effects on two immune mechanisms. This article is highlighted in the In This Issue feature, p. 517.
abstract_zh: 通过多种机制杀伤肿瘤的药物具有广泛的临床获益潜力。在此，我们首先开发了一种计算机多组学方法（BipotentR），用于发现同时调节肿瘤免疫和另一致癌通路的癌细胞特异性调控因子，并利用该方法识别出38个候选免疫-代谢调控因子。我们展示了这些调控因子的肿瘤活性，通过机器学习和深度神经方法，根据患者对抗PD-1的反应对黑色素瘤患者进行分层，这提高了当前生物标志物的预测能力。识别出的首要调控因子ESRRA，在免疫治疗耐药肿瘤中被激活。其抑制通过抑制能量代谢和激活两种免疫机制杀伤肿瘤：（i）细胞因子诱导，导致促炎性巨噬细胞极化，以及（ii）抗原呈递刺激，将CD8+ T细胞招募至肿瘤中。我们还通过将BipotentR应用于血管生成和生长抑制因子逃逸通路，展示了其广泛适用性。BipotentR（http://bipotentr.dfci.harvard.edu/）为评估患者反应和发现同时通过多种机制作用的药物靶点提供了资源。意义：BipotentR提供了评估患者反应和识别可同时通过多种机制杀伤肿瘤的药物靶点的资源。对首要候选靶点的抑制通过抑制能量代谢及对两种免疫机制的影响杀伤肿瘤。本文被收录于“本期内容”专题，第517页。
